title: Open Food Facts products
cohort: First 8,000 source records, retaining named products and deduplicating barcodes. This is a curated source-order cohort, not a representative sample of the food market.
transformations: English/main name selected; namespace prefixes removed from displayed tags. Nutrients are per 100g/100ml as supplied. A single category is chosen for exclusive grouping; original category tags retained. Missing allergen tags do not establish allergen absence.
